entities.summary: Johnson Kwaku Adu is a Ghanaian politician and member of the Seventh Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana and the 8th Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana. He represented the Ahafo Ano South West Constituency in the Ashanti Region on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party.
